game.title: Pathfinder: Kingmaker
game.blurb: Party-based fantasy RPG in which you found a barony in the Stolen Lands and grow it into a kingdom, from Owlcat Games, released 2018-09-25. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genre: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From the night attack on the Aldori mansion and the bandit king to founding a barony, its threats, and the final enemy.

chapters.title: Ruling the Kingdom
chapters.summary: Kingdom stats and leaders, claiming and developing regions, resource locations, kingdom events and the royal artisans.

chapters.title: Companions and Side Quests
chapters.summary: Recruiting companions and their quests, romance, the Storyteller's artifacts, the royal hunt, the tiefling guest and other side quests.

chapters.title: Varnhold's Lot
chapters.summary: The Varnhold's Lot campaign and Lostlarn Keep.

chapters.title: Beneath the Stolen Lands
chapters.summary: The dungeon Beneath the Stolen Lands, in rogue-like mode and in the main campaign.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Winning on Challenging rules, Unfair and Last Azlanti mode, and the Hard-mode bear fight.

chapters.title: Feats and Fun
chapters.summary: Unarmed blows, knockdowns, metamagic, merchants, goblin songs, the Eldest of Time and carrying heavy loads.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for Pathfinder: Kingmaker (API returned missing for "Pathfinder: Kingmaker" and for "Pathfinder Kingmaker"). pathfinderkingmaker.fandom.com answers the API, with 17 linked pages, including "Kingdom", "Companions", "Beneath The Stolen Lands", "The Wildcards" and "Varnhold's Lot"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam store list names app 640820 "Pathfinder: Kingmaker — Enhanced Plus Edition". 13 of 74 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though most are rare (1.2 to 5.2%) and some names ("Evil Is My Name", "Taking No Sides", "In The Name Of The Law") sound like alignment or ending goals. The visible story achievements (1 to 11 and "The Story's End") were placed by name. "Not What It Seems", "Patricide" and the hidden "The Tiefling Trio" (59 to 61) may be "The Wildcards" add-on, but the text does not say so; they sit in side quests. "Lost And Found" (Lostlarn Keep, "while playing the main story campaign") sits in the Varnhold's Lot chapter because it is listed among that campaign's achievements, which is a judgement call; "And The Murderer Is..." (Blackstones Ford inn) sits in side quests.
